title: Possible a PostgreSQL sslpassword option in source
description: The file contains a PostgreSQL sslpassword option. The format is ordinary text, so committing the file exposes the whole credential to everyone with repository access. Shape-only: the match does not prove the credential is live.
remediation: Rotate the credential the file describes, delete the file from the repository, and provision it at run time from a secret manager or the platform credential store with restrictive permissions.
limitation: Shape-only: the rule recognises one file format and one credential position inside it. It cannot prove the value is live and it does not parse the surrounding document.

tests.line: # sslpassword is prompted at connection time
